title: mammillaria marshalliana
intro: Mammillaria marshalliana, commonly known as Marshall's Pincushion Cactus, is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include the relief of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. Mammillaria marshalliana is reported to have therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial and antioxidant effects, making it a valuable plant for medicinal purposes. The bioactive constituents of Mammillaria marshalliana include flavonoids and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
